scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gym-log/contracts && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --watch apps/api/src/server.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test apps/api/test/app.test.ts apps/api/test/config.test.ts packages/contracts/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run docs:check
scripts.db:logs: sudo docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml logs postgres
scripts.test:db: node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/api/test/database.integration.test.ts apps/api/test/schema.integration.test.ts apps/api/test/auth.integration.test.ts apps/api/test/domain.integration.test.ts apps/api/test/setup.integration.test.ts
scripts.admin:bootstrap: npm run build -w @gym-log/contracts && node --env-file=.env --import tsx apps/api/src/auth/bootstrap-cli.ts
scripts.test:domain: npm run build -w @gym-log/contracts && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test apps/api/test/domain.integration.test.ts
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @gym-log/contracts && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --watch scripts/dev-api.mjs
scripts.test:web: npm run build -w @gym-log/contracts && npm run build -w @gym-log/web && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/web/test/browser.integration.ts apps/web/test/setup.integration.ts
